nodes.label: Tailwind CSS Utility Reference
nodes.rationale: Reference doc covering core utility classes for layout, spacing, typography, colors, borders, shadows, width/height, and arbitrary values.

nodes.label: Layout Utilities
nodes.rationale: Display (block/flex/grid/hidden), flexbox justify/align/gap/wrap, grid columns/rows/span/gap, positioning (static/relative/absolute/fixed/sticky), z-index.

nodes.label: Spacing Utilities
nodes.rationale: Padding/margin all sides and directional, space-x/space-y, spacing scale from 0 to 24 (0px to 6rem).

nodes.label: Typography
nodes.rationale: Font size (xs-5xl), font weight (thin-black), alignment, line height, combined utilities, transform, decoration, overflow (truncate/line-clamp).

nodes.label: Colors
nodes.rationale: Text/background colors, 11-shade scale (50-950), opacity modifiers (/75, /30, [0.87]), gradients (to-t/to-tr/.../to-tl, from/via/to).

nodes.label: Borders
nodes.rationale: Border width/color/radius/style, rounded-full (9999px), individual corners (rounded-t-lg, rounded-br-xl), solid/dashed/dotted.

nodes.label: Shadows
nodes.rationale: Shadow scale shadow-sm through shadow-2xl plus shadow-none, colored shadows with opacity (shadow-blue-500/50).

nodes.label: Arbitrary Values
nodes.rationale: Square-bracket custom values for spacing/colors/sizes/CSS variables/complex values (p-[17px], bg-[#bada55], bg-[var(--brand-color)]).
